title: Add `docs/README.md` as concise index and lifecycle summary for OctoAcme process docs
body:
Adds a dedicated `docs/README.md` entry point for OctoAcme project-management documentation. The README consolidates the lifecycle summary, role definitions, and direct navigation to all process guides in `docs/`.

- **What changed**
  - Added a new `docs/README.md` focused on fast onboarding and discoverability.
  - Captured the end-to-end process flow in concise form:
    - initiation (need/goals/metrics/stakeholders/risks/go-no-go)
    - planning (prioritized estimated backlog, acceptance criteria, DoD, dependencies, milestones, release plan)
    - execution/tracking (board flow, small PRs, CI/review, metrics, blocker escalation)
    - risk/communication (risk register, mitigations, stakeholder updates, single source of truth)
    - release/deployment (acceptance, CI/security, release notes, smoke tests, rollback, staged rollout, verification, announcements)
    - retrospective/continuous improvement (lessons learned, measurable actions)
- **Roles captured**
  - Brief role descriptions for Project Manager, Product Manager, Developers, QA/Testing, and Stakeholders.
- **Documentation index**
  - Added relative links from `docs/README.md` to all existing process docs so navigation works from within the `docs/` folder.

```md
## Documentation Index
- [Project Management Overview](./octoacme-project-management-overview.md)
- [Project Initiation](./octoacme-project-initiation.md)
- [Project Planning](./octoacme-project-planning.md)
- [Execution and Tracking](./octoacme-execution-and-tracking.md)
- [Risk Management and Communication](./octoacme-risks-and-communication.md)
- [Release and Deployment](./octoacme-release-and-deployment.md)
- [Retrospective and Continuous Improvement](./octoacme-retrospective-and-continuous-improvement.md)
- [Roles and Personas](./octoacme-roles-and-personas.md)
```
